app.title: agatesim: simulate agate formation and judge the result against form criteria
app.summary: The person starts from a target form's verified preset, or picks a model, cavity shape and parameters themselves. They then adjust settings, timelines of conditions and the seed, with undo, redo, reset and a bounded Randomize. A live preview redraws as a rendered slab with each of the form's quantitative criteria marked pass or fail and band statistics beside it. Settings that look promising go to a full-resolution background run that is saved. A saved run can be pinned and set beside another, with its criteria, statistics and setting differences, and the person can export a report or a growth animation.

task.text: Find which model settings and conditions over time reproduce a target pattern, by simulating it and checking the result against quantitative criteria for that pattern.

data.text: Simulation configurations (model, cavity outline, parameters, scheduled conditions, seed) and the simulated 2D material fields they produce, rendered as images with per-criterion measurements and band statistics; saved runs are kept as records.
data.item: one simulation run: a configuration and the cross-section it produces

stage.text: exploring which mechanism and conditions reproduce a target form, then comparing runs

mechanism.text: A settings sidebar drives a live preview: every change re-simulates and redraws the slab, the criteria pass/fail table and the band statistics. A run list beside it opens saved full-resolution runs, and pinning one puts its slab, criteria, statistics and setting differences side by side with the current one, with a shared growth slider.

field.text: forward simulation of mineral banding, checked against quantitative form criteria, in geology

workflow.name: tune a simulation until its output meets the criteria for a target pattern

steps.here: The Form menu loads a verified preset for a target form at the procedural or mechanistic tier, and the result is then judged as that form. Other presets can be loaded too, or the person picks a model and a cavity shape (preset or drawn).

Parameter sliders carry units and a physical, effective or imposed badge. A timeline editor sets steps, ramps and pulses for scheduled conditions, and there are size and rotation sliders, tube placement by clicking the preview, and a seed. Undo, redo, Reset (with a count of changed settings) and Randomize (with a strength and an option to stay within the form) move through settings.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Each change re-runs a preview simulation. The slab is drawn in reflected, shadow or iris light, with angle sliders and a growth slider that replays the formation over time.
The criteria panel lists each of the form's quantitative tests with its measured value, its threshold and pass or fail, and gives an overall verdict. Band statistics are shown below it.
Run full resolution starts a background job at a chosen resolution, with a caution badge for heavy work. The job is saved as a reproducible run in the run list, which can also delete runs.

Pin for comparison puts a saved run next to the preview or another run. Their slabs, criteria and statistics sit side by side, a diff lists the settings that differ, and Grow both together links their growth sliders.
Export report saves the configuration and its evaluation; the slab view can also export a growth animation.

distinctive: Every target form has fixed quantitative criteria with thresholds, so a run is judged as reproducing the form or not, rather than by eye.
Models are split into procedural (by design) and mechanistic (from physics) tiers, and every parameter is badged physical, effective or imposed.
Conditions can change over formation time through a timeline of steps, ramps and pulses.
Randomize moves the key settings within bounded ranges and can keep only draws that still pass the chosen form's tests.
Heavy previews and runs are estimated in advance: a caution badge warns, and a heavy preview waits until the person presses Build it.
